audit_note: Full 18/18-book citation audit completed 2026-09-13 (see maintainers/audit/reports/KANTANDA_AUDIT_DOSSIER-1.md): 53.7% of the 82 book-cited rules had citation defects (misattributed chapter, fabricated section, or content contradicting the source). Citation corrections for those findings were applied 2026-09-13, and Tier-1/2/3 gap-analysis follow-up (17 new rules covering previously-uncited gaps: OOM streaming ingestion, SSRF allowlist/IMDSv2, multi-layer Anti-BOLA, LLM code sandboxing, ML model deserialization safety, Ports & Adapters, EventStorming, HNSW tuning, embedding versioning, Object Mother/Humble Object, class-level SRP, Three Laws of TDD, Playwright visual regression/storageState/axe-core/Faker.js, and feature-poisoning resistance) was added 2026-09-15. Status is not 'fully verified': FW-IDEM-001 (idempotency framework) and 2 items (model-extraction defense, F.I.R.S.T. properties) remain either unsourced-by-design or intentionally not added due to lack of genuine textual support in the 18-book corpus.
